title: Windows New Local User Created
description: Alert-ready search for Security Event 4720, indicating that a user account was created on a monitored Windows host.
query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Security Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Event Security Logs') and 'Event ID' = '4720' | stats count as UsersCreated, earliest(Time) as FirstSeen, latest(Time) as LastSeen by 'Log Source', 'Target User Name', 'Subject User Name', 'Host Name (Server)' | sort -UsersCreated
